content: Per-runtime healthchecks: binary must exist in image. eclipse-temurin alpine ships busybox wget -> wget -qO- http://localhost:8080/actuator/health | grep UP works; Debian-slim JRE images ship NEITHER curl nor wget. python:slim ships neither -> use python urllib one-liner or apt-get curl. node:alpine has busybox wget (verify flags) or write tiny healthcheck.js using http module. apache/kafka image: kafka-broker-api-versions.sh --bootstrap-server localhost:9092 as test command. postgres pg_isready, redis redis-cli ping. Common failure: check targets published host port instead of container port; wrong endpoint path returning 404. start_period generous for JVM (Flyway/Hibernate cold start 30-90s low-RAM).
